# TASK-149 — NVIDIA NIM provider

- **Status:** Done — implemented and verified
- **Area:** NVIDIA NIM provider (2026-10-01)

## Intent

Add `nvidia-nim` beside OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama and Claude Agent. It speaks the OpenAI chat protocol, so proposals (`generate`), model listing and the streaming tool-calling conversation reuse one OpenAI-compatible path with a different base URL and key. Default host is the free hosted API Catalog; `NIM_BASE_URL` points at a self-hosted NIM (no key needed, URL checked, no embedded credentials). The key is stored like the other provider keys (encrypted, write-only, never returned or logged). NIM is a network provider: local-only projects keep refusing everything except Ollama, even when NIM is self-hosted (private-network NIM for local-only projects is backlog). Hosted free-tier rate limits (429) are retryable.

## What it delivers

One OpenAI-compatible path shared with OpenAI (`openaiHost`, `openaiTurn`); address rules and model filter in `nim.ts`. Tests: `tests/nim.test.ts` (fake OpenAI-compatible server), `integrations.test.tsx`. Verified: the hosted model list's public shape, the Settings card in the browser. Not verified: a chat call against the real hosted service (needs a key; see TASK-150).
